'''Nihei''' (Japanese: '''ニヘイ''' ''Nihei'') is a recurring character in {{aniseries|XY}}. He is the younger brother of [[Ippei]] and the older brother of [[Sanpei]] and hails from [[Ninja Village]]. Nihei is the second strongest of the village, only behind Ippei. 

==History==
[[File:Sanpei Froakie.png|left|thumb|250px|Nihei and his brothers]]
Nihei was first mentioned by [[Sanpei]] in ''[[XY017|A Rush of Ninja Wisdom!]]'', and was only featured in a fantasy. 

Nihei physically debuted in ''[[XY099|The Legend of the Ninja Hero!]]'', where he was making preparations for the village festival. He welcomed Sanpei, when he returned to the village, accompanied by {{Ash}} and his {{ashfr}}. He then had [[Pokémon battle]] with Sanpei to test his brother's strength, and managed to win despite having the [[type]] disadvantage.

While he and Ippei showed Sanpei and Ash's group the temple dedicated to the village's heroes, [[Ninja Village]] came under attack from [[Kagetomo]] and his Ninja Corps. Nihei accompanied Ippei in facing the army of {{p|Skarmory}} while Sanpei and Ash tried to protect chief {{kal|Hanzo}}. While the brothers did their best, the enemy forces suddenly retreated after achieving their main aim - kidnapping Hanzo. Thanks to [[Saizo]], Nihei joined the others and headed for [[Otori Mountain]] to save Hanzo.

Upon arriving at Otori Mountain, the group got attacked by [[Heidayu]] and the ninja army. In ''[[XY100|A Festival of Decisions!]]'', Nihei used his {{p|Venusaur}} to battle the enemy ninjas, alongside {{an|Serena}}, {{an|Clemont}} and [[Shinobu]]. They eventually managed beat them, while Ippei defeated Kagetomo and saved Hanzo.

The day after the village's festival, Nihei said goodbye to Ash and his friends. After their departure he informed Ippei and Hanzo about the [[Bond Phenomenon|mysterious power]] of [[Ash's Greninja]] he had witnessed.

==Character==
Nihei is highly regarded for his strengths and skills as a Trainer, coming only second to his older brother [[Ippei]]. Like his other brothers, he has a competitive streak and is equally dedicated to protecting [[Ninja Village]] from harm.
